title: Outcome
description: How a task ended. Every task ends in exactly one outcome; `blocked` and `error` must say which decision the owner needs to make. Outcomes are also emitted as wake events so a later manager can listen to them.

task_id.description: Id of the task that ended.

responsibility.description: The responsibility the task belonged to.

outcome.description: done: finished, nothing needed. ready: work is ready for approval (a PR). blocked: stopped by a rule or permission. error: something else broke and the bulb couldn't fix it within its limits. skipped: woke up but the event isn't something it handles.

tried.description: What the bulb tried, one entry per attempt or step.

decision_needed.description: The decision the owner needs to make; required when the outcome is blocked or error.

links.description: Related links: the PR, the run, logs or a check.

verification_signal.description: The verification signal used: the repo's CI checks, a platform check, the configured verify commands, or none.

cost.description: What the task cost, summed across wake-ups.

minutes.description: Runner wall time in minutes (CI waiting not counted).
